prompts.prompt: Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached square game sprite. Preserve the exact small golden hanging chandelier: same golden metal, number and shape of upward glowing bulbs, silhouette and proportions, smooth HD game-illustration look. Keep its exact logical placement centered horizontally at the VERY TOP of the square canvas, occupying approximately x=30%..70% and y=0%..30%, as in the reference. This composition is essential for the game engine. Remove the ENTIRE gray oval/strip along the bottom edge: the engine will draw floor light itself. Also remove the rectangular yellow/gray background around the chandelier. The finished sprite contains ONLY the chandelier and its actual bulbs/metal with clean antialiased alpha cutout edges. All the rest of the square canvas, especially the entire bottom 70%, must be completely alpha-zero transparent. No glow haze or light spill outside the fixture, no floor, no ground shadow, no light pool, no background rectangle. Keep ample empty canvas below; do NOT center or enlarge the chandelier to fill the image. True transparent background. Preserve original recognizable colorful look, render smooth high-resolution edges without pixel-block artifacts, black outlines, text or added parts.
